facts.fact: The High Commissioner for Digitalisation said the draft national digital transformation strategy (5 axes, 25 strategic objectives) was approved by the commissariat's steering council on 28 May 2024 and its latest version was submitted to the Presidency about a month before the July 2024 interview.

The article states the Haut-Commissariat à la numérisation, created by presidential decree 23-314 of September 2023 under the Presidency, is charged with following and implementing the national digitalisation strategy.
